decisions.title: Unusable conversion-chain policy
decisions.factual_question: Should conversion writes refuse unusable resolved chains, or should resolution skip/clamp them?

decisions.consequence: Already-refused overflow is not silent corruption. Skipping/clamping would change relationships; decision L for scalar factors does not answer this.
decisions.recorded_answer: Atomically refuse writes that would produce unusable conversion chains, and return a specific error.
decisions.recorded_effect: Reject the write before committing any chain mutation; add concurrency and rollback coverage.
